name: roslyn-mcp
description: Use Visual Studio's live Roslyn workspace from Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor with per-repository MCP ports.

interface.shortDescription: Query Visual Studio's live Roslyn workspace
interface.longDescription: Installs a bundled Visual Studio extension, configures an isolated per-repository MCP endpoint, and routes C# semantic questions through the live Roslyn workspace in Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $roslyn-setup-repo to connect this repository to Roslyn MCP on port 5051.
